newsitem.title: TURKEY: Trade mixed on Istanbul gold exchange.
newsitem.headline: Trade mixed on Istanbul gold exchange.

text.p: There was a mixed day of trade on the Istanbul gold exchange on Tuesday with 500 kilos of trade in the morning session and none in the afternoon. Meanwhile prices remained steady in dollar terms and lira prices fell.
Gold closed at $368.80 an ounce, from $368.70 on Monday and 1,246,600 lira per gram, versus the previous 1,250,700.

"Gold prices seemed to bottom out in world markets which encouraged demand from investors. By the afternoon, investors switched their interest to the Treasury's 13-month bond auction," one dealer said.
Gold's easing in lira terms was due the Turkish currency's firming against the dollar, dealers said. The lira closed at 105,200 to the dollar against 105,280 on Monday.
With no trade in the afternoon, volume stood at 500 kilos, down from Monday's 742 kilos. 76 percent of trade was in lira terms.
